Sign catalogue

Sign

M106

Looks like: five short vertical strokes

Adapted from the field-cady sign descriptions (Parpola 125). This describes the picture, not the meaning: a sign that looks like a fish may stand for a sound or another word.

Wells W005 · Unclassified

Appears in 27 texts (38 uses), mostly on seals at Mohenjo-daro; found at the start, middle and end of texts. In the larger ICIT corpus its Wells equivalent W005 is in 39 texts, including at Dholavira.

Where it appears 27

Counts are distinct texts in the Mahadevan 1977 concordance (a text repeated on many moulded tablets counts once). 38 objects in all carry it.

Project tests 8

Role in the text

Positional class
Unclassified. Its raw label was medial, but it did not keep that label reliably. Grammar
Functional reading
NUMERAL(short) 1.00. Short-stroke numeral 5. two stroke systems with complementary heads (shaunmortal F2/F5/F8, ICIT replicated); numeral precedes head Functional reading

Role names such as opener or noun are labels for positions, not tested meanings.
